messages:
Sam: Quick heads-up — deploying service-search v1.4.2 to prod tonight 02:00 UTC. Staging canary looks good but I want a final rollback/runbook sanity check. Primary rollback owner? :rocket:

Maria: I'm primary for rollback, Devon is backup. I'll be on the window. What's the smoke checklist and the explicit rollback criteria?

Sam: TL;DR smoke + rollback criteria: 1) GET /search?q=health returns 200 consistently 2) P95 latency < 150ms (baseline) 3) 5xx rate stays <= 0.5% (critical threshold 1.0%) 4) embeddings pipeline lag < 2s per job. Rollback triggers: any sustained 5xx >1% for 5m, latency P95 +30% above baseline for 5m, or backlog in embeddings queue > 5min for 10m.

Sam: Pasting the condensed runbook (keep this thread as canonical):

```
Rollback runbook — service-search (v2)
1) Stop new traffic: set feature flag search_v1=false or set traffic split to previous version.
   - curl -X POST $FF_API/flags/search_v1 -d '{"enabled":false}'
2) Scale down new deploy: kubectl scale deploy service-search-v1-4 --replicas=0 -n prod
3) Scale up previous stable: kubectl scale deploy service-search-v1-3 --replicas=5 -n prod
4) If DB migration was applied: confirm migrations are backward-compatible. Only run migration revert if absolutely necessary and after DB lead approval.
5) Run escape-hatch script (ops only): sh /infra/scripts/rollback_service_search.sh --env prod --from=1.4.2 --to=1.4.1
6) Validate: run smoke checks, check errors in Sentry, verify embeddings queue drain.
Decision: if step 1-3 restore baseline metrics within 15 minutes, consider rollout aborted. Else escalate to SEV process.
```

Jordan: Quick question — does the rollback require DB schema revert? I thought the migration was additive.

Li: Confirmed: migration added a shadow column and backfilled asynchronously. No schema revert required for a standard rollback. DB lead gave the OK for rollback without revert.

Devon: Escape hatch script is ready in repo. It needs runbook ACK + ops-bot approval to run in prod. Script does the traffic flip and scales k8s resources.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled for 02:00 UTC. I'll post status updates and CI links when rollout starts.

Maria: ACK. I'll run the smoke checklist and watch Sentry + Grafana. If thresholds hit, I'll execute the rollback script and post status here. Devon will assist if I need escalation.

Sam: Please also prep a short postmortem template if we hit rollback. Keep the rollback window: 02:00-03:00 UTC.

oncall: oncall: I'll monitor the dashboards and alerting. Set alert thresholds: error rate 1.5% and P95 latency +40% as pager thresholds. I'll escalate to SEV if those fire.

Devon: Quick command snippet to run when needed:
```bash
ssh ops@jumpbox
sudo sh /infra/scripts/rollback_service_search.sh --env prod --from=1.4.2 --to=1.4.1 --confirm
```

Maria: :thumbsup: I'll post a final GO 30m before the window (01:30 UTC). If I don't post GO, we hold.

Sam: Thanks everyone — final checklist link: https://confluence.redwood/ops/rollbacks/service-search. Please read the runbook and confirm here if you're good. Running a short run-through at 01:30 UTC (10min) to simulate smoke checks.

Jordan: Reacted :eyes: — will stand by.

Maria: ACK (primary rollback owner).

Devon: Backup ACK.

Sam: Closing notes: keep this thread for async updates during the window. If anything changes ping #oncall-alerts in addition to this thread.
